,"response":"It sounds stressful to stand on that platform, anxious and wanting to get to dinner, and then to arrive to silence. The train cancellation really did stop you from taking your planned train, and you tried to send word. I can't say why A went quiet, since I only have your side. A might not have gotten your message, or might have felt something you don't know about yet. When things are calmer, you could tell A what happened on your end, then ask what the wait was like for them and really listen to the answer."}
